name: Bundesbeauftragter für den Datenschutz und die Informationsfreiheit

submission.postalAddress: Bundesbeauftragter für den Datenschutz und die Informationsfreiheit, Graurheindorfer Str. 153, 53117 Bonn, Germany

procedural.notes: The BfDI has a narrow federal remit: it supervises federal public authorities, telecommunications providers, postal services, and federal social insurance bodies. Complaints against private-sector website operators almost always fall to the Land-level DPA where the controller is established, not the BfDI. Complaints can be filed via the online form at formulare.bfdi.bund.de, by email to poststelle@bfdi.bund.de, or by post to Graurheindorfer Str. 153, 53117 Bonn. Working language is German.
